rooms.name: Luna River Crossroads
rooms.desc: Two roads cross here. By the eastern corner the stump of a broken signpost leans out of the ground; the rest of it, four arms and all, lies in the long grass a few paces away.
rooms.dm: Always check for a random encounter here. Rejoined, the sign reads: Krezk and Tsolenka Pass south-west, Lake Baratok north-west, Vallaki and Ravenloft north-east, Berez south-east. The Old Svalich Road (NE to SW) is level; a quarter mile north-east an arching stone bridge crosses the Luna River. The north-west branch climbs gently, a dirt trail within half a mile, rejoining the Old Svalich Road after a couple of miles with a branch to Van Richten's Tower on Lake Baratok (V). The south-east trail wends down along the river to Berez (U).

objects.label: Snapped signpost
objects.desc: A splintered post, all that still stands of a signpost, leaning askew.

objects.label: Signpost's top half
objects.desc: The top of the signpost lies in the weeds, its four arms pointing every which way.

objects.label: North-east: Vallaki (N); the Luna River bridge a quarter mile on.
South-west: the Old Svalich Road to Krezk (S) and the Tsolenka Pass road.
North-west: Lake Baratok and Van Richten's Tower (V).
South-east: down the river valley to the ruins of Berez (U).
